verdict.rationale: Deepgram's own trust docs let users control retention per request: setting mip_opt_out=true means opted-out requests are not retained, while default requests are retained under the Model Improvement Program. The evidence does not document any deletion of already-retained data, retention windows, or account-level retention settings, and it does not explicitly confirm the flag applies to the Voice Agent WebSocket. Missing for 10: documented deletion of stored data, configurable retention periods or account-wide controls, explicit Voice Agent applicability, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Opt out per request with mip_opt_out=true. Opted-out requests are not retained
Requests participate in the Model Improvement Program (MIP) by default, and Deepgram retains them
